anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: Nothing moved: After keeps the explicit row-2 deviation clause ('the table has 40 columns, so the export includes the 12 visible-by-default columns (Design clause 3)'), lists no blockers, still offers merge as the recommended row 1 with stop last, mints no blocker for the spec-deviating row, and posts nothing without a pick; show evidence correctly moved out of the numbered rows into the hint line, and 'Not offered: approve (your own PR)' is a sensible addition. One minor wording regression worth reverting: the Delivers opening sentence changed from 'exports a 12-column CSV' to 'exports a compact CSV', which drops the concrete column count from the summary and makes the reader rely on the later deviation clause to learn it—keep '12-column CSV' in the first sentence so the deviation is visible both in the summary and in the per-AC clause, while retaining the new shared-menu rows and hint exactly as written.
